reading: The loop has five links: the recommendation is written, reaches a responsible clinician, is acknowledged, is acted on, and the follow-up is completed. Retrieved records show that codes improve the first link, alerts depend on the second, navigators and tracking lists repair the middle of the chain, and letters bypass the clinician at the cost of some worry. Patients without a primary care clinician and emergency-only patients break the chain at the second link. A model lead offering a national benchmark is not part of the evidence until it is checked.
